question: Yash travels 204 km at 68 km/hr, the next 424 km at 53 km/hr and the next 366 km at 61 km/hr. What is his average speed (in km/hr) for the whole journey? (Corrected to two decimal places)
solution:
**Given:**

Distance 1 (D₁) = 204 km

Speed 1 (S₁) = 68 km/hr

Distance 2 (D₂) = 424 km

Speed 2 (S₂) = 53 km/hr

Distance 3 (D₃) = 366 km

Speed 3 (S₃) = 61 km/hr

**Formula used:**

Average Speed = Total Distance / Total Time

Total Distance = D₁ + D₂ + D₃

Total Time = (D₁ / S₁) + (D₂ / S₂) + (D₃ / S₃)

**Calculations:**

Total Distance = 204 + 424 + 366

⇒ Total Distance = 994 km

Total Time = (204 / 68) + (424 / 53) + (366 / 61)

⇒ Total Time = 3 + 8 + 6

⇒ Total Time = 17 hours

Average Speed = Total Distance / Total Time

⇒ Average Speed = 994 / 17

⇒ Average Speed = 58.47 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**
